title: Chainport Cardano Bridge - COPICafe Episode 30 | Cornucopias
description:
Chainport and Cornucopias bring BSC/Cardano Bridge to Ecosystem!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob give a brief update on the Derp staking partnership, discuss all of the development happening behind the scenes on the new Cornucopias web site. Rob mentions some recent updates on the desktop launcher which will be previewed shortly. The Chainport co-founders drop in to discuss the bridge, their security measures, their impressions on developing in Cardano and wrap up discussing their thoughts on Cornucopias. And of course, the episode wouldn't be complete without a few leaks from the art department.

Chainport: https://www.chainport.io
DcentraLab: https://www.dcentralab.com
Tokensfarm: https://tokensfarm.com/

00:00 - Introduction
02:18 - Derp Partnership
03:25 - Beverage Choices
04:52 - Website Development
06:10 - Desktop Launcher
07:17 - Special Guests: Chainport Co-Founders
10:53 - Why Chainport?
13:55 - Hardware Wallets
16:18 - Impressions of Developing on Cardano
29:20 - IOG Involvement
30:24 - Thoughts on Cornucopias
39:47 - Reaching Other Communities
41:20 - LEAKS

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
